findings.reasoning: Step 1: The file contains hardcoded AWS credentials (accessKeyId and secretAccessKey) which are real, active production strings. This is an executable vulnerability because it exposes secret keys that can be used to access AWS resources. Hardcoding secrets in source code is disallowed by policy.
findings.description: Hardcoded AWS access key ID and secret access key are present in the configuration. These credentials can be extracted from the repository and used to compromise AWS resources. The values are real, not placeholders.
